name: Hypomania Checklist (HCL-32-R1)
directions: Think of a period when you felt unusually high, energetic or active. For each statement, indicate whether it describes you during such a period. This self-report checklist does not establish a diagnosis.

questions.text: I need less sleep.
I feel more energetic and more active.
I am more self-confident.
I enjoy my work more.
I am more sociable (for example, I make more phone calls or go out more).
I want to travel and do travel more.
I tend to drive faster or take more risks when driving.
I spend more or too much money.
I take more risks in my daily life, work or other activities.
I am physically more active (for example, sport).
I plan more activities or projects.
I have more ideas or am more creative.
I am less shy or inhibited.
I wear more colourful or extravagant clothes or make-up.
I want to meet or actually meet more people.
I am more interested in sex or have increased sexual desire.
I am more flirtatious or sexually more active.
I talk more.
I think faster.
I make more jokes or puns when talking.
I am more easily distracted.
I engage in lots of new things.
My thoughts jump from topic to topic.
I do things more quickly or more easily.
I am more impatient or get irritable more easily.
I can be exhausting or irritating for others.
I get into more quarrels.
My mood is higher or more optimistic.
I drink more coffee.
I smoke more cigarettes.
I drink more alcohol.
I take more drugs (such as sedatives, anxiolytics or stimulants).
